question: Should the dashboard agent-status widget proceed as a sessions.list-backed builtin in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826, or should it wait for a richer sessions.activity Gateway contract first?
rationale: The requested UI is coherent, but the durable source of truth for current task, progress, attention, and cross-agent activity is a product/API decision automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Keep staged dashboard builtin
options.body: Treat the open PR as the candidate UI solution while requiring its review blockers and real behavior proof to clear before closing this issue.

options.title: Wait for activity contract
options.body: Keep this issue open until the broader Gateway activity contract lands, then implement the widget against that stable API.

options.title: Fold into roadmap tracker
options.body: Let the roadmap issue own sequencing, but preserve this issue's specific agent-status requirements before closing it later.

recommendation.title: Keep staged dashboard builtin
recommendation.body: Treat the open PR as the candidate UI solution while requiring its review blockers and real behavior proof to clear before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the clearest current-main and live-assignee signal across the sessions/activity contract and adjacent UI/gateway paths.
